title: Record the zero-saving centre moment
body:
## Summary
- With one unpaid coordinate, width 896/9 and centre 112, the saving-zero moment is `1 + (112 - 896/9)/(73*896/9) = 585/584`.
- The value is above one. A rank-1 profile and a profile with one rank-51 child give the same moment, because every rank unit costs 1/73.
- No new kappa. The 704 columns stay unreplayed.
